ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious Activity Using SeCEdit
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential suspicious behaviour using secedit.exe. Such as exporting or modifying the security policy

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\secedit\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "SeCEdit") AND (((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/export.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/cfg.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/configure.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/db.*"))))
